description.p: Desktop app for Linux that reads and manages WireGuard® interfaces on Linux servers over SSH: status and handshakes, new clients with QR code, editing, disabling and removing peers, and comparing app, server file and runtime.
Every change on a server shows a diff first and runs with a backup and an automatic rollback timer. Server private keys and preshared keys never leave the server.
